description: This PHP script handles deletion of bugs associated with test executions in the TestLink open source test management system. It processes GET parameters to identify execution and bug IDs, performs permission checks, logs audit events, and renders a confirmation or result message using Smarty templating.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns the GET/SESSION parameters needed for bug deletion, including execution ID, test case step ID, bug ID, and test project ID.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies whether the current user has the 'testplan_execute' right on the project, determining if they can access the page.
